SELECT ha.hero_id, s.superhero_name, s.race_id, r.race, ha.attribute_id, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
LEFT JOIN race r ON r.id = s.race_id
LEFT JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS heroes FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
LEFT JOIN race r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)
GROUP BY r.race
ORDER BY n DESC;
